ntp_pool.description: NTP pool hostname used for initial synchronization. Use a region-specific pool like '0.pool.ntp.org' for reliability.

ntp_servers.description: List of specific NTP servers to use as primary or backup sources.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server.

iburst.description: Enable iburst (fast initial sync) for this server.

prefer.description: Mark this server as preferred (used when multiple servers are available).

enable_hwtimestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping support (requires compatible NIC and kernel config).

logging_levels.description: Log levels to enable; choose from: raw, packets, stats, data, events, measures, timing, tracking, rtcout, temp, clockstats, nts.

enable_cmdauth.description: Enable command authentication for chronyd (requires chrony.conf key file setup). Typically unnecessary for client-only in secure environments.
